verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents an explicit Agent Testing feature that verifies conversational responses, tool usage, and full multi-turn outcomes before deployment, including converting real conversations into simulated test cases, plus success-evaluation criteria for assessing conversation quality/goal achievement — directly matching the pre-deployment simulated testing story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report validating test accuracy or CI-integration details, and no explicit mention of automated eval scoring pipelines beyond docs description.
